in_marathi.name: Leeladhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine play or sport
in_marathi.long_meaning: Leeladhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Leeladhar is a name of divine origin, derived from the Sanskrit words 'leela' (play, sport) and 'dhar' (to uphold). The name symbolizes the divine play or sport of the gods, reflecting the concept of the universe as an expression of divine will. It is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy in Hindu tradition.
